26:112.text: He said: "And what knowledge have I of what they used to do?

26:113.text: "Their account is only with my Lord, if you could

26:114.text: "And I am not going to drive away the believers.

26:115.text: I am only a plain warner."

26:116.text: They said: "If you cease not, O Nûh
you will surely be among those stoned

26:117.text: He said: "My Lord! Verily, my people have belied me.

26:118.text: Therefore judge You between me and them, and save me and those of the believers who are with me."

26:119.text: And We saved him and those with him in the laden ship.

26:121.text: Verily, in this is indeed a sign, yet most of them are not believers.

26:122.text: And verily your Lord, He is indeed the All-Mighty, the Most Merciful.

26:124.text: When their brother Hûd said to them: "Will you not fear Allâh and obey Him?

26:125.text: "Verily I am a trustworthy Messenger to you.

26:126.text: "So fear Allâh, keep your duty to Him, and obey me.

26:127.text: "No reward do I ask of you for it
; my reward is only from the Lord of the ‘Âlamîn

26:128.text: "Do you build high palaces on every high place, while you do not live in them?

26:129.text: "And do you get for yourselves palaces
as if you will live therein for ever.

26:131.text: "So fear Allâh, keep your duty to Him, and obey me.

26:132.text: "And keep your duty to Him, fear Him Who has aided you with all

26:133.text: "He has aided you with cattle and children.

26:135.text: "Verily, I fear for you the torment of a Great Day."

26:136.text: They said: "It is the same to us whether you preach or be not of those who preach.
